main_text.head: Eiusdem Amyraldi, de natura & efficacitate misericordiæ in-teruentu diuinæ Prouidentiæ patefactæ, sententia.
main_text.p: Quam salus nulla sit citra fidem, fides nulla sine obiecto quod ad credendum inuitet, & facultate quae ob-iectum amplectatur, est aliquid pariter breuissime dicendum de utraque illa re eorum respectu qui verbi diuini mini[?]-sterio carent.
Facultas quae obiecto recipiendo de-stinata est, quaeque mens appellatur, considerari debet vel[?] in se, vel quatenus à Spiritu Dei affecta est.

Et in se quidem corruptam eam esse funditus, & vitiis cum naturalibus tum acquisitis ita praepeditam, ut nullum obiectum divinum extrinsecus oblatum recte amplecti queat, AMYRALDUS constantissime docuit, demonstrauitque argumentis Def. Caluini. cap. Sexto. Conc. VI. de Natura Evangelii, &

page.notes: Right edge: a column of single letters (r, e, t, c, &, p, r, a, v, b) lies beyond the printed text block. It is the neighbouring page or show-through, so it is left out. "Quam": the Q is a large initial, and the rest of the word is joined to it. "mini[?]": damaged letters before the line-end hyphen. "vel[?]": the word before "in se" is partly obscured, read as "vel". "Caluini" and "AMYRALDUS" are kept as printed. Printed "Caluini" may be a misprint for "Calvini". Left as printed.
